name: Model Auto Enricher
title: Model Auto Enricher
subtitle: One click to restore 1M context windows, image input and reasoning effort tiers on every model channel
description: Scans every provider and model in cordis.patch.yml and fills in contextWindow, maxTokens, input and reasoningEfforts from the built-in series rule matrix. A timestamped backup is written before any change; the pass is strictly idempotent and never lowers a larger existing value.
statusHint: Reads the live cordis.patch.yml of this profile
actionHint: Fills missing or capped specs from the rule matrix. A cordis.patch.yml.bak-auto-enrich-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss backup is written first.
actionHintDry: When everything is already optimal nothing is written and no backup is created.
noChanges: ✨ All model specs are already optimal — nothing to change.
footerNote: Rules: dsh-model-auto-enricher v2.0 series matrix (GPT-4o~6+ / Claude 4~5.5+ / Gemini / DeepSeek / GLM / Kimi / Hunyuan / mainstream + universal new-model fallback, with live auto-watch).
